## SOURCE_MAP (lineages)

- L1 Covariant cosmography: Kristian–Sachs 1966 → Heinesen 2021 (E-X01) → Maartens et al. 2024 (E-X02) → Kalbouneh et al. 2026 (E-X03). HTT R32-01/05 sit at the O(z) truncation of L1.
- L2 Observational H_0 anisotropy with SNe/TF: Dhawan 2023 (E-X05) → Cowell 2023 (E-X04) → Boubel 2025 (E-X06) → Stiskalek 2025 (E-X07) → Salzano 2025 (E-X08) → Kalbouneh 2026 (E-X03). Conflict axis: PV correction / bulk-flow vs intrinsic.
- L3 Bianchi CMB: Pontzen–Challinor 2007 (E-X12) → Saadeh 2016 (E-X10) → Planck 2015 XVIII → Vicente–Pereira–Pitrou 2025 AniLoS/AniCLASS (E-X11).
- L4 Astrometric cosmology: Darling 2014 (E-X13) → Darling+ 2018 (E-X15) → Marcori+ 2018 covariant drifts (E-X14) → Gaia DR3/Quaia VSH 2024 (E-X15).
- L5 Planck null simulations: FFP10 (PR3) → NPIPE PR4 600 E2E (E-X18) → PR4 anomaly studies (E-X19).
- L6 Foreground moments: Chluba 2017 → Remazeilles 2021 → Vacher 2022 (E-X20).

## MISSING_EVIDENCE

- M-01: Whether NPIPE A/B/full simulations share one CMB (and foreground) realization per index (needed for L03 "same-realization genealogy"); not confirmed from texts read. Check NPIPE paper §5 / NERSC README.
- M-02: Numerical dispersion of dust β, T within Planck beams/lines of sight (Planck 2018 XI; Planck Int. XXII) to set ρ for the bounded-moment class.
- M-03: Validation of AniLoS/AniCLASS against ABSolve/ANICOSMO or Pontzen–Challinor templates (not published in E-X11).
- M-04: Explicit covariant proper-motion response including vorticity (B1) and acceleration (E1 aberration drift) for a tilted observer in a Bianchi VII_h background; literature read gives Bianchi I (shear only) and FL (velocity/acceleration only).
- M-05: Public location of the Pantheon+ nominal SALT2 surface / per-survey .nml; not in Brout 2022 text.
- M-06: Cause of the CF4 0.147 vs 0.138 zero-point discrepancy (EDD documentation or author contact).
- M-07: Full text of Kalbouneh 2026 §6 giving the explicit θ, a, σ mapping and the treatment of the observer boost v_o in the quadrupole.

## NEGATIVE / NULL RESULTS (literature)

- Stiskalek 2025: no evidence for intrinsic H_0 anisotropy once PV field is reconstructed.
- Dhawan 2023 / Cowell 2023: no significant Hubble quadrupole in Pantheon(+); 1σ limit 2.88 %.
- Saadeh 2016: 121,000:1 against anisotropic (VII_h) expansion with Planck 2015 T+P.
- Darling 2014: Hubble expansion isotropic to 7 % from VLBI proper motions.
- Vacher 2022: β-2 moment scheme biased (degenerate with CMB) — warning for free second-order relaxations.
